supported_claim: Submarine cables carry more than 99% of international data flows
caveat: This is about international data flows; it does not mean every internet connection or packet is underwater.

supported_claim: ITU 2025 snapshot describes 500+ operational systems and about 1.4 million km
caveat: A dated snapshot; do not treat as a live counter.

supported_claim: ICPC FAQ describes about 500 systems and around 1.8 million km
caveat: Different date/scope from the ITU 2025 snapshot; do not combine totals as if measured identically.

supported_claim: ICPC reports roughly 150–200 faults a year and 70–80% associated with accidental human activity
caveat: The ITU 2025 report separately gives 86% from human activity; figures differ by source/scope. Narration attributes the 70–80% range to ICPC.

supported_claim: Route surveys consider seabed conditions, existing infrastructure, hazards and route constraints
caveat: Generalized description only; no precise route coordinates or sensitive vulnerabilities.

supported_claim: Installation guidance covers route survey, cable laying, fault localization, cable recovery and sea repair
caveat: Methods vary by depth, seabed and system design.

supported_claim: Submarine optical cable characteristics and protective constructions vary by cable category
caveat: Do not present one cable cross-section as universal; label diagrams illustrative.

supported_claim: Design guidance addresses optical power budgets and impairments in submarine optical systems
caveat: Specific repeater/amplifier architecture varies by system.
